description: This file provides utility functions for managing popout windows in the Mattermost web and desktop applications, including opening thread, plugin, search, and help popouts, as well as handling communication between popouts and parent windows.

methods.name: registerRHSPluginPopoutListener
methods.description: Registers a listener for RHS plugin popout events based on plugin ID.

methods.name: popoutThread
methods.description: Opens a thread popout window and sets up message handling for reply posts.

methods.name: popoutRhsPlugin
methods.description: Opens a plugin-specific RHS popout window.

methods.name: popoutRhsSearch
methods.description: Opens a search results RHS popout window with specified search terms and parameters.

methods.name: sendToParent
methods.description: Sends a message to the parent window, handling both desktop and browser contexts.

methods.name: onMessageFromParent
methods.description: Sets up a listener for messages from the parent window.

methods.name: isPopoutWindow
methods.description: Checks if the current window is a popout window.

methods.name: isThreadPopoutWindow
methods.description: Checks if the current window is a thread popout for specific team and thread ID.

methods.name: canPopout
methods.description: Determines if the current environment supports opening popouts.
